audit.why: Tricky framing is right: Wind Wall blocks Naafiri Q daggers and the R projectile portion of poke, level 6 knockup+Last Breath flips all-ins, but pack melee pressure beats his weak pre-crit early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer said Skill on rows 1 through First item while content named winners; content win[4] said Naafiri while whys[4], spikes[1] and mid all say level 6 flips to Yasuo.
audit.why: Aligned both layers to the page's own consistent prose: Naafiri L1-L4/5, Yasuo at 6 and first item, Naafiri at 2+ items. Packet chart puts Yasuo at first item and Naafiri at 6 — prose (knockup into Last Breath at 6) is kit-grounded, so 6 goes to Yasuo; noted for QA.
Wind Wall (25s rank 1, 17s max, blocks projectiles 4s) vs Naafiri Q projectile is stated; melee pack damage ignoring the wall is stated; knockup into Last Breath respected. Ability names all real.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. It governs your forward steps. - E Eviscerate spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s max, blocks projectiles for 4s — hold your Q until it is spent, then you own a 20-second window. - His Last Breath is only 70/50/30s; it is nearly always up. - Hold your R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: Your E dash recalls the packmates and fully heals them — pass through his flurry and the dogs come out repaired.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Without the pack you are half a champion — Yasuo's E-Q flurry shreds a lone Naafiri, so dive only with dogs up.

edits.before: Yasuo wins by landing Wind Wall, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Yasuo wins by walling your daggers, riding minion dashes onto you, and cashing a third-Q knockup into Last Breath.

edits.before: Trade behind the screen and bleed the contacts — your early strings out-stat most of the lane's expectations.
edits.after: Pre-crit Yasuo is weak: punish every Sweeping Blade onto minions with Q-auto trades, and never throw Q into the wall.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Late, the pack's melee damage ignores Wind Wall — flank, R the carry when his knockup is spent, and exit before he resets.
